D‑Wave has announced a major hardware breakthrough that improves its ability to perform quantum error correction, a key requirement for scalable quantum computers. The new design enhances the fidelity and stability of qubits, thereby reducing the error rates that currently limit practical computation. This development is seen as an important step toward achieving fault‑tolerant gate‑model quantum computing.
